description: This file contains JavaScript functions and classes for handling lookup dialogs, popups, collapsing panels, AJAX requests, and related UI interactions within a web application, specifically for a common theme in an OFBiz framework project.

classes.name: Lookup
classes.description: Class managing lookup dialog interactions, including AJAX loading, dialog positioning, and event handling.

classes.name: FieldLookupCounter
classes.description: Counter object for managing multiple lookup instances and their references.

classes.name: ButtonModifier
classes.description: Class for modifying lookup UI elements, such as collapsing panels, buttons, pagination, and result tables.

classes.name: lookupDescriptionLoaded
classes.description: Helper class for loading and updating lookup field descriptions via AJAX.

methods.name: getViewNameWithSeparator
methods.description: Constructs a view URL with the correct separator ('?' or '&') based on existing query parameters.

methods.name: lookup_error
methods.description: Displays an error alert with a given message.

methods.name: lookup_popup1
methods.description: Opens a lookup popup window with specified view, form, and size parameters.

methods.name: lookup_popup2
methods.description: Opens a second type of lookup popup with additional arguments.

methods.name: fieldLookup1
methods.description: Constructor for a field lookup object handling validation and popup invocation.

methods.name: fieldLookup2
methods.description: Constructor for a field lookup object handling two target controls.

methods.name: call_fieldlookup3
methods.description: Creates a fieldLookup2 instance and invokes its popup2 method.

methods.name: call_fieldlookup
methods.description: Creates a fieldLookup1 instance and invokes its popup method with default sizes if not provided.

methods.name: call_fieldlookup2
methods.description: Creates a fieldLookup1 instance and invokes its popup2 method.

methods.name: CollapsePanel
methods.description: Collapses or expands a UI panel.

methods.name: initiallyCollapse
methods.description: Automatically collapses panels if configured to do so.

methods.name: initiallyCollapseDelayed
methods.description: Delays the initial collapse of panels.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Main class managing lookup dialog lifecycle, AJAX data loading, and event handling.

methods.name: FieldLookupCounter
methods.description: Manages unique keys and references for multiple lookup instances.

methods.name: ButtonModifier
methods.description: Modifies lookup UI elements, including collapsing, buttons, pagination, and result table links.

methods.name: lookupAjaxRequest
methods.description: Performs AJAX load of lookup content.

methods.name: lookupFormAjaxRequest
methods.description: Performs AJAX form submission for lookup.

methods.name: lookupPaginationAjaxRequest
methods.description: Performs AJAX pagination for lookup results.

methods.name: setSourceColor
methods.description: Highlights a source element.

methods.name: set_duration_value
methods.description: Sets a value in the calling window for duration fields.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets a value in the calling window.

methods.name: set_values
methods.description: Sets multiple values in the calling window.

methods.name: write_value
methods.description: Writes a value into a target input element.

methods.name: set_multivalues
methods.description: Sets multiple values into a target and triggers change events.

methods.name: closeLookup
methods.description: Closes the lookup dialog window.

methods.name: lookupDescriptionLoaded.init
methods.description: Initializes the lookup description loader.

methods.name: lookupDescriptionLoaded.update
methods.description: Fetches and updates the description tooltip for a lookup field.
